name: Swader Map
what: A viral Bangla web toy where people tick the famous food of each of Bangladesh's 64 districts they have eaten and share their own X/64 map card.
hard_part: Each district's food was cross-checked across five source families, with low-confidence districts flagged for correction. Ads run from a separate origin inside a sandboxed iframe so third-party scripts never touch the main page, and nothing a visitor ticks or types leaves the browser.
demo_note: Open and tap foods; no sign-in
facts: Shareable map card image generated in the browser
Map data: BBS / OCHA via geoBoundaries
Format credit: Sabbir Hossien Robin's bd-maps
